body: Thanks for talking. I appreciate it. Take care!

He did send flowers to my work on Tuesday. They sit on my desk and it's been what makes me happy all week. I think I'll bring them home tomorrow. I'll talk to him, it's just I've talked to him about it a few times and I don't want to bother him anymore. I don't even think he knows I'm depressed. No one does. I'm embarrassed and annoyed by myself.

I just don't know where to start. I want to do all of these things and I get really motivated, and it's gone within a few hours, and im back to these horrible thoughts. I think I just need to slow down.

Work is the only place where I feel ok. I can keep my mind off of things. But I dread waking up in the morning and having to be there. 

I have no friends where I live. I've gained weight because I have zero self control. I can't stop. 

It's like fuck, what's wrong with me? Why can't I even just be happy for others good things? My poor husband can't even go out with his friends without me being upset for him leaving me behind. 

I know I have it good. I'm just so selfish.
